stem:
Neil grows a money-plant cutting and watches a potato sprout from an eye.

Which claims correctly identify a new organism made without seeds from two parents? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: A money-plant cutting that grows into a new plant is vegetative propagation from one plant part.
A potato sprouting from an eye produces a new plant from a stem part, not from two parents' seeds.
A money-plant cutting needs pollen from a second parent before it can grow.
Bacteria dividing into two identical individuals still require seeds from two parents.

teacher.key_rationale: Vegetative propagation from a cutting or potato eye, and asexual division, produce new individuals without seeds from two parents. Requiring pollen for a cutting, or treating bacterial division as seed-based, misses that hinge.
